description:
This quiz tests knowledge of advanced and semantic HTML5 elements beyond basic <div> and <span> usage. It appears beginner-to-intermediate in difficulty and uses a playful, informal, mildly teasing teaching tone to encourage semantic HTML practices.
Topics: HTML5 semantic elements, Choosing semantic HTML over generic containers, Distinguishing <div> and <span> from more meaningful elements, HTML skills assessment
Audience: Beginner to intermediate web developers and learners reviewing or strengthening their HTML5 fundamentals
